faqs.question: Is CUET UG the same as CUET PG Law?
faqs.answer: No. CUET UG is the undergraduate NTA paper for central universities. CUET PG Law is the postgraduate law paper used for DU’s 3-year LLB. Do not buy one and assume it covers the other.
